projects.title: TapMart
projects.description: TapMart is a modern e-commerce storefront built for a smooth online shopping experience. It includes product browsing, cart management, checkout flow, order tracking, and admin product handling with a clean and responsive interface.

projects.title: Tap
projects.description: Tap is a real-time chat application built with the MERN stack and Socket.IO. It supports one-to-one messaging, image sharing, user authentication, profiles, and live community chat rooms with room creation, private passwords, member limits, and real-time member tracking.

projects.title: Banking Transaction API
projects.description: A secure banking-style REST API built with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. It supports JWT authentication, account management, system funding, user-to-user transfers, atomic balance updates, idempotency protection, immutable ledger entries, and transaction email notifications.
